english.note: This is the everyday noun for positive liking or a favorable feeling toward a person or thing.

exampleSentences.english: I have quite a fondness for this restaurant.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對呢間餐廳幾有好感。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 jau5 hou2 gam2

english.note: Use this for the personal positive feeling or liking someone develops toward a person or place.

exampleSentences.english: I gradually developed an attraction to this new colleague.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對呢個新同事慢慢有咗好感。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 go3 san1 tung4 si6 maan6 maan6 jau5 zo2 hou2 gam2
